title: Solid body
spec: Create a cylindrical base by first setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a closed loop made up of four arcs and four lines. The first arc starts at the point (0.0, 0.0042), passes through the midpoint (0.0012, 0.0012), and ends at (0.0042, 0.0). The first line connects from (0.0042, 0.0) to (0.0208, 0.0). The second arc begins at (0.0208, 0.0), has a midpoint at (0.0238, 0.0012), and ends at (0.025, 0.0042). The second line runs from (0.025, 0.0042) to (0.025, 0.0208). The third arc starts at (0.025, 0.0208), goes through (0.0238, 0.0238), and concludes at (0.0208, 0.025). The third line extends from (0.0208, 0.025) to (0.0042, 0.025). The fourth arc begins at (0.0042, 0.025), passes through (0.0012, 0.0238), and ends at (0.0, 0.0208). Finally, the fourth line completes the loop by connecting from (0.0, 0.0208) back to (0.0, 0.0042). After drawing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.025 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to generate the final three-dimensional model. The resulting solid body will have a length of 0.025 units, a width of 0.025 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0042) \
     .threePointArc((0.0012, 0.0012), (0.0042, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.0208, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.0238, 0.0012), (0.025, 0.0042)) \
     .lineTo(0.025, 0.0208) \
     .threePointArc((0.0238, 0.0238), (0.0208, 0.025)) \
     .lineTo(0.0042, 0.025) \
     .threePointArc((0.0012, 0.0238), (0.0, 0.0208)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0042) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Scale the sketch (if necessary)
# Note: The sketch scale is applied to the sketch before extrusion, but in this case, it is 0.025 which is the same as the dimensions provided, so we can skip scaling.

# Final model
r  # This will represent the final model

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane in the XY plane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Start the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0250)  # Starting point
r = r.lineTo(0.0250, 0.0250)  # Line 1
r = r.threePointArc((0.0250, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0))  # Line 2
r = r.close()  # Close the sketch

# Extrude the sketch to a length of 0.7500 along the Z-axis
r = r.extrude(0.7500)

# The part is now stored in 'r'
